note: Every number on an Atlas page comes from one of these sources or is computed from them by a function in lib/. A source without a licence that allows commercial reuse is not listed. maxAgeDays is the freshness gate: a page whose data snapshot is older is held back from publication and flagged for refresh.

sources.name: Wikidata city items joined on the GeoNames id (P1566)
sources.note: Used when the GeoNames dump is not yet ingested. The time zone is then set only for countries with a single IANA zone in the runtime CLDR data; cities in multi zone countries get none and are held back.

sources.name: Wikidata country facts
sources.spotCheck: 2026-09-22: 255 countries pulled. Plug types missing for GB, DE, US, JP, GR, NL, RO and wrong for IT (only L listed; Italy uses C, F and L); currency empty for FR, NL, CZ (several values, not resolved); JP emergency number empty; US official languages listed as ch, es, sm. Not fit to print. City guide pages stay blocked until a verified country facts source replaces it.

sources.name: NASA POWER daily point data 2011-2020, reduced to monthly normals
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0; 'There are no restrictions on the use, access, and/or download of data from the NASA POWER Project' (AWS Open Data Registry entry)
sources.attribution: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program
sources.caveat: Modelled values for a 0.5 by 0.625 degree grid cell (MERRA-2 based). They describe the area around the city, not a weather station, and are stated as such on the page.
sources.derivation: scripts/ingest/nasa-power.mjs: for each calendar month, the mean of the daily maxima and minima over 2011 to 2020, the mean monthly precipitation total, and the mean number of days with at least 1 mm of precipitation.

sources.name: Sunrise, sunset and day length
sources.attribution: Computed from the city coordinates with the NOAA solar position equations

sources.name: Great circle distance
sources.attribution: Computed from coordinates (haversine, mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km); straight line, not road distance
